headline: German Auto Sector Hit by 24-Hour Strikes Over Pay Dispute
summary: Trade union IG Metall has initiated 24-hour strikes across 19 northern German sites, impacting production at Mercedes-Benz, BMW, and Siemens Gamesa. The walkouts are part of a widening pay dispute.
why: Germany's automotive sector is a pillar of the European economy; prolonged labor disputes can disrupt supply chains and impact quarterly earnings for major manufacturers.

impacts.name: Mercedes-Benz
